- **Portfolio shape:** e2e (68) + web (35) = 84% of all cases; api 6, security 5, performance 3, integration 3, mobile 3.
- **Automation risk gap:** critical is 1/32 automated (3%), high 31/57 (54%), medium 24/34 (71%) — the highest-risk cases are the least automated.
- **Sync:** 55 script mappings, 54 synced, 0 script-updated, 2 case-updated (sync health 96).
- **Staleness:** 50 cases counted stale, 0 updated recently.
- **Data caveat:** get_coverage_stats / get_health_score report 122 cases / 55 automated, one fewer than get_analytics, get_automation_stats and dashboard (123 / 56); 123/56 is used throughout and the 1-case gap looks like a lagging index.

cells.content:
## Executive Summary — Sprint 2 (V1.1)

- **Sprint health: amber.** The last two CI suite runs (*Sanity Test*) both passed 9 of 10 tests (90%), and the newest run was green — but across the full 30-day window only 23 of 39 executed tests passed (59%) and the sprint plan TP-2 stands at 8 passed / 1 failed of 9 executed.
- **Biggest risk #1 — shop filter/checkout path.** `ShopPage.applyProductFilters` times out on `selectOption` for `filter-category` (30s) in 4 consecutive runs each for the Maya Patel and Leo Grant checkout personas — this single page-object method accounts for the two highest failure counts in the project.
- **Biggest risk #2 — auth entry points.** The only open **critical** defect (D-2) is the Admin 2FA login (`getByTestId('username')` never visible), and the Manager login is blocked by the `promo-overlay` intercepting the Sign-in click. Both are on the login journey, so a release gate on authentication is not currently satisfied.
- **Coverage is the quiet gap.** 46% of cases are automated and only **1 of 32 critical-priority** cases has a script; requirement coverage is nevertheless 100% (20/20), so the risk is depth of verification, not traceability.
- **Recommended next steps.** (1) Stabilise `ShopPage.applyProductFilters` — wait for the filter panel before `selectOption`, or route filters via URL params. (2) Fix `promo-overlay` handling in `LoginPage.submitManagerCredentials` and assign D-2 to the auth owner. (3) Automate the 31 un-scripted critical cases before the V1.1 release gate, prioritising auth and checkout. (4) Re-baseline on the next full suite run so the trend stops being dominated by 1-test runs.

cells.content:
## What the numbers say

**The library is wide but shallow.** 56 of 123 cases (46%) are marked automated and 57 scripts exist, yet only 24 distinct automated cases (19.5%) have ever been reached by a recorded execution — and just 20 (16.3%) passed. The gap between "automated" and "executed" is where coverage is actually being lost, not in authoring.

**Risk sits in the wrong place.** Critical cases are 32 of 123 (26% of the suite) but hold 1 automated script (3.1%); high is 54% and medium 71%. Requirement coverage reads 100% (20/20) while **0 requirements are backed by an automated case** — largely because 55 cases carry no requirement link at all, so the two percentages measure different things and should be read separately.

**Execution is the binding constraint.** 33 of 57 scripts have no recorded run, and the newest execution of any kind is 16 Nov (a single local script) with the newest suite run on 14 Nov (Sanity Test 9/10, 90%; Self Check 3/4, 75% on 9 Oct). Self Check and Sanity are the only two suites defined, so most of the library is outside any repeatable run.

**The red set is one bug, not eleven.** 10 of the 11 failing scripts die inside the shared admin sign-in path (`getByTestId('username')`, 15s) covering TC-37…TC-46 — all six admin-dashboard cases and four admin-settings cases. The eleventh (Manager login, unlinked) is blocked by the `promo-overlay` intercepting the submit click. Additionally, 7 scripts flip outcomes between runs (flakiness 22–50%), 4 of them in `tests/shop`, so shop greens are not trustworthy yet.

**Priority order:** fix the admin auth locator and re-run the admin/profile specs (recovers 10 scripts and 10 test cases); link the 28 unlinked scripts so their results count; run or retire the 33 never-run scripts starting with `tests/forms` (6) and `tests/dynamic` (5); automate critical cases before adding more medium-priority breadth.

cells.content:
## What this says

- **Nothing executed in the last 24 hours.** `automation_report` returns 0 finished runs since Nov 18; the last finished run was on **Nov 16, 06:11 UTC**. Execution freshness is the single biggest drag on the health score.
- **The Nov 14 window carries all the failures.** 11 finished runs between Nov 12 and Nov 19 executed 31 tests: **19 passed, 12 failed → 61.3%**. Eight distinct tests account for the 12 failures.
- **Two hard-failing scripts:** both Manager checkout journeys (Maya Patel, Leo Grant) have never passed — 0% pass rate over 4 recorded runs each, all dying at `ShopPage.applyProductFilters` waiting for `filter-category`. That looks like a page-structure or readiness problem in the shop filter sidebar, not test flakiness.
- **Page drift:** `Shop · TestverQA: page identity` fails because the `<h1>` reads **"Store"** where the test expects **"Shop"** — an expectation to confirm with the product owner, not necessarily a bug.
- **Flakiness is real but bounded:** four tests flip outcomes in ≥20% of consecutive runs (50% each on 3-run samples). Treat those pass counts as unreliable until the underlying waits are hardened.
- **Coverage is healthy on paper, thin in practice:** 100% requirement coverage and 96% sync health, but only 45% of test cases are automated and **33 of 57 scripts have never run**.
- **Suite view:** Sanity Test last completed at 90% (9/10, Nov 14); Self Check is stale — last completed Oct 9 at 75% (3/4).
